title: 'Every Day Gets Harder': Victim's Family Speaks 2 Years After Serbia's Novi Sad Station Collapse
content:
On November 1, 2024, 20-year-old Andjela Ruman arrived by train in Novi Sad, where her boyfriend was waiting for her. They died together when the station canopy collapsed.

Two years on, her parents, Zorica and Zlatko Ruman, speak to RFE/RL about how they have been coping with their loss.
